sources.name: background
sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production clean background for a portrait4:5 jigsaw painting,1280x1600. Scene: an inviting warm library corner with curved wooden shelves, seen from slightly above. Dominant deep BERRY RED and rose on broad plaster walls, curved painted shelves and a large upholstered reading chair; warm ivory pages, darkgold wood trim and small green accents. Detailed dimensional hand-painted storybook illustration, tactile paper, velvet and wood, soft sunlight from the upper-left, rich small discoveries and distinct puzzle features. Generic travel interior, no recognizable city or landmark, no people, letters, numbers, words, logos, UI or border. Books have beautiful blank embossed covers. A small round side table at lower-right holds an open book, a ceramic tea cup with no steam and a plain empty bud vase. An empty small plant pot sits on a shelf at upper-left. A cushion on the reading chair has no decorative tassel. A book on the lower-left table has a short fixed ribbon end but no loose ribbon tail. Fully paint natural background surfaces beneath five later moving details: cup steam, vase flower sprig, potted leafy tip, cushion tassel, loose silk bookmark tail. Do not paint those five foreground details yet; no blank cutout rectangles. Cohesive painted depth and elegant cozy composition, not a photograph or flat vector.

sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game sprite atlas for a warm, detailed hand-painted travel jigsaw. Genuine transparent RGBA background, absolutely no colored backdrop, no haze, no glow, no drop-shadow halo. Landscape 1536x1024. Invisible 3-column by 2-row grid, each cell 512x512. Five independent objects, sixth lower-right cell completely empty. Each whole object must fit inside the central 300x300 pixels of its cell with at least 100px fully transparent padding on every side. Objects MUST NOT touch cell boundaries. No drawn grid, no labels or text, no ground surfaces. Crisp painted texture, natural light upper left, thin clean alpha edges. Paint exactly these five objects, one per cell in reading order: (1) narrow cream tea steam wisp tapering to a very fine bottom point, soft but no glow; (2) delicate pale peach flower with a long bare green stem ending in a pointed tip; (3) small olive-green leafy plant sprig with visible bottom stem to sit in a library terracotta pot; (4) tiny burgundy silk tassel hanging from a single short loop, golden thread accents; (5) a muted burgundy satin bookmark ribbon with V-cut lower tip, long and narrow. These will be placed into a rich berry-red library with antique gold wood, a cup, small vase, empty shelf pot, cushion corner and book.
